notes: More of the email on screen. The bands above the preview were taking 337px of the pane on a full window and 366px on a half-screen one; they now take 242 and 277, which is about 100 extra pixels of email either way. The five buttons all stay, and fit on one row on a full window. The subject sits on one line with the whole thing on hover, and the label is just Confirmation rather than Confirmation preview. New Details button at the top right folds the subject, who it's going to and the notes away entirely, leaving the buttons and the view switch - that gives about 660px of email instead of 429. Anything marked FIX stays on screen folded or not, and the app remembers how you left it.
